# Sivam Pillai

> Personal site and thinking lab of Sivam Pillai — AI systems, manufacturing, ideas, and musings. Primary topics: industrial intelligence, time-series ML, energy-aware systems, applied AI in factories, startups, and occasional creative work (poetry, design, photography).

Sivam Pillai is a CTO and co-founder building applied AI for industrial systems (PhD). This is a personal blog and profile site, not a company marketing site. He publishes project case studies, essays, blog posts, short notes, quotes, and creative work. Many project and blog posts reference Zolnoi (industrial AI for manufacturing).

**When to use this site vs LinkedIn:** Use this site for authored long-form thinking, project narratives, and curated resources. Use [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sivampillai) for professional history, roles, and network context.

**How to navigate:**
- Main nav: Home, Projects, Writing (Essays, Blog, Quotes, Notes), Creatives (Design, Poetry, Photography), About, Now.
- Footer also links: Collections, Resources, Search, Contact.
- **Search:** `/search` — Pagefind full-text search over published content; filter by section.
- **Related content:** At the bottom of many essays, blog posts, projects, notes, and quotes, items with shared `tags` are linked (Thinking Lab).
- **Machine-readable index:** `https://sivampillai.com/sitemap.xml`
- **Slug URLs:** Content URLs use the Markdown filename stem (e.g. `e003-llm-2026` → `/essays/e003-llm-2026`). Only entries with `publishStatus: published` appear on the live site.

**Licenses:** Site code is MIT; written content is CC BY 4.0 unless noted. Attribute when reusing content.

## Start here

- [Home](https://sivampillai.com/): Tagline, intro, and a Featured sampler (project, essay, creative, quote).
- [About](https://sivampillai.com/about): Bio, values, and background in industrial AI and time-series.
- [Now](https://sivampillai.com/now): Current focus (work, research, activities, off-script); updated periodically.

## Projects

- [Projects index](https://sivampillai.com/projects): Industrial AI, monitoring, tools, and experiments.
- [DataVed](https://sivampillai.com/projects/x001-dataved-tool): Streamlit time-series exploration dashboard.
- [Eval Sakhi](https://sivampillai.com/projects/x002-evalsakhi-agent): AI evaluation agent for structured eval plans.
- [Autobot line follower](https://sivampillai.com/projects/x003-autobot-line-follower): Early robotics competition build (2009).

- [Essays index](https://sivampillai.com/essays): Longer reflective and technical pieces.

- [Deep learning evolution (2016)](https://sivampillai.com/essays/e002-deep-learning-2016): How deep learning moved from theory to traction.

- [The 5 C's that shaped my life](https://sivampillai.com/essays/e005-5cs-of-my-life): Competence, courage, confidence, connection, conscience.
